descriptions.w3d_d40j_task_manager_add_80164514: Task manager add: takes a free slot from the pool chosen by the task type kind (10: pool 0, 11: pool 1, else pool 2), resets it, links it under the parent handle, references the task, adds its id to the pool's timer queue (STLport vector with push_heap) or active list (STLport vector), runs the start hook 0x8034b418 at a mode chosen by the task type (4, 3, 5 or unchanged), restores the engine mode and returns the slot id. Names are inferred.
